provenance_note: In vivo DddB table (3.0.6). Accessible-state probabilities: logit p = logit p_naked + 0.488, keeping the sequence-context dependence of the encoder-indexed naked-DNA table (models/legacy/dddb_nanopore_naked_2f10003c.json); the level is 1.245x the naked-table burden, set against matched PacBio Hia5 Fiber-seq at the hb, ind, scyl and chrb amplicons; capped at 0.95. Protected state, start and transition probabilities are those of the naked table.
